about: Ms. Lewis is a Certified Family Law Specialist, by the State Bar of California Board of Legal Specialization. She is also a Fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers (AAML). Ms. Lewis is currently the President of the Northern California Chapter of the AAML. AAML Fellows across the United States enjoy a reputation for professionalism, competence and integrity. She graduated from Wellesley College and UCLA Law School and was admitted to the California Bar in 1988. Ms. Lewis is a founding partner of Madigan & Lewis, LLP, a full-service family law firm serving California clients primarily in San Mateo and Santa Clara Counties. Madigan & Lewis, LLP, provides clients with exceptional legal representation in family law matters: including divorce; paternity; custody and visitation; domestic violence; marital property; alimony & child support; and prenuptial and postnuptial agreements. Ms. Lewis is an AAML Certified Mediator and has represented her clients at both the trial and appellate court levels.

In May 2020, I was granted Fellowship in the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers ("AAML"). The AAML was established in 1962 and is comprised of the top matrimonial attorneys throughout the nation, AAML members are recognized as preeminent family law practitioners with the highest levels of knowledge, skill, and integrity. In order to be elected, each Fellow must successfully complete a rigorous selection process that includes interviews, examinations, and professional and judicial evaluations.The AAML is comprised of 1,600 Fellows who are located in every state.
